item.title: UK games industry joins government delegation to China for the first time
item.description: Ukie has marked a first for the UK games industry as British studios join a UK government-backed business and cultural delegation to China led by Prime Minister Keir Starmer. The delegation also includes Ukie Chair Maria Sayans of ustwo Games and Ukie member Donna Orlowski of Chucklefish, joining Keir Starmer and Peter Kyle to promote the global appeal of British-made games. ... [MORE]

item.title: Lil Wayne to headline Supercell's Clash Royale virtual halftime show
item.description: Supercell has revealed that music star Lil Wayne will headline a virtual halftime show inside Clash Royale ahead of this year's big game event. The performance will premiere globally on February 6th, 2026, with Lil Wayne delivering a special rendition of his hit single A Milli inside the Clash Royale arena, available to watch in-game at 09:00 PST, 12:00 EST and 17:00 GMT. ... [MORE]

item.title: Games emerge as a dominant entry point into youth fandoms in the US and UK
item.description: Games have emerged as the dominant entry point into youth fandoms across the US and UK. According to a new study by SuperAwesome, 86% of children and teens aged 4 to 18 are connected to a fandom, with gaming consistently acting as both the first point of discovery and the strongest driver of long-term loyalty. ... [MORE]

item.title: Epic Games Store sees record $400m in third-party player spending
item.description: Player spending on third-party titles on the Epic Games Store rose 57% to hit a record $400 million in 2025. That's according to the company's 2025 Year in Review, which showed that players logged 2.78 billion hours in third-party games, up 4% from 2024. However, overally gameplay hours declined year-over-year to 6.65bn. ... [MORE]

item.title: LootLocker makes strategic investment in indie label Pantaloon
item.description: Cross-platform backend firm LootLocker has made a strategic investment into UK-based indie label Pantaloon. Pantaloon offers an email newsletter through which it recommends games and partners to readers looking for new indie titles. ... [MORE]

item.title: Nexon to refund MapleStory Idle RPG players following pricing error
item.description: Nexon has issued an investor update outlining the financial and operational fallout from a coding error in MapleStory: Idle RPG. The South Korean developer discovered on January 25th 2026, that a coding issue had misapplied probability/statistical values for certain paid items. ... [MORE]

item.title: Ares Interactive raises $70m as it plots expansion plans and new game launch
item.description: Ares Interactive has raised $70 million in a Series A investment round to expand its operations and launch a new baseball game in 2026. The company was founded by former Glu Mobile CEO Niccolo De Masi and is headed up by president Mike DeLaet, who previously worked at Mattel as global head of digital gaming and Scopely as SVP of strategic partnerships. ... item.title: Nominations open for the first Top 30 US Mobile Game Makers 2026
item.description: We have opened nominations for the brand new Top 30 US Mobile Game Makers 2026 list, set to be unveiled during the Pocket Gamer Connects Summit San Francisco on March 9th. It will act much like our Top 30 Mobile Game Makers list but with a key difference: we’ll be focusing on the US’s best mobile game companies. ... [MORE]

item.title: Why Pocket Gamer Connects Summit San Francisco and why now?
item.description: One thing was clear as the industry recently came together at Pocket Gamer Connects London, one of Europe’s top B2B games events: the return of optimism. Now the PG Connects sails are set for the US, the world’s second largest games market, and San Francisco, home of GDC Festival of Gaming and its myriad of surrounding events. ... [MORE]
